mapper.select: SELECT * FROM callsession FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM contact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND phone IN #{phone}
SELECT s.* FROM conversationstate s JOIN callsession c ON c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.id=s.call_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.attempt IN (c.attempts,c.attempts+1) AND c.id IN #{id}

SELECT p.phone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phonesuppression s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.phone=p.phone) AS suppressed,
(SELECT d.legacy_component FROM dial_daily_counter d WHERE d.generation_id=#{dailyGeneration} AND d.scope_type='phone' AND d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.phone_digest=UNHEX(SHA2(p.phone,256)) AND d.phone=p.phone AND d.window_start=p.day_start AND d.timezone_revision=p.zone AND d.ready=TRUE) AS legacy_attempts, (SELECT d.event_component FROM dial_daily_counter d WHERE d.generation_id=#{dailyGeneration} AND d.scope_type='phone' AND d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.phone_digest=UNHEX(SHA2(p.phone,256)) AND d.phone=p.phone AND d.window_start=p.day_start AND d.timezone_revision=p.zone AND d.ready=TRUE) AS event_attempts,
(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.attempts),0) FROM callsession c FORCE INDEX(ix_callsession_phone_active) WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.phone=p.phone AND c.created_at>=p.day_start) AS legacy_attempts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM callsession c FORCE INDEX(ix_callsession_phone_active) STRAIGHT_JOIN callevent e FORCE INDEX(ix_callevent_call_session_id) ON c.id=e.call_session_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.phone=p.phone AND e.event_type='dial_attempt_claimed' AND e.created_at>=p.day_start) AS event_attempts,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM callsession c FORCE INDEX(ix_callsession_phone_active) WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.phone=p.phone AND c.status IN ('DIALING','ANSWERED','IN_AI','WAITING_HUMAN','HANDOFF_TRANSFERRING','IN_HUMAN')) AS active FROM (SELECT CONVERT(#{p.phone} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS phone,#{p.day} AS day_start,CONVERT(#{p.zone} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS zone) p

SELECT c.id,c.tenant_id,c.attempts FROM callsession c LEFT JOIN campaign p ON p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND p.id=c.campaign_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.status='QUEUED' AND c.attempts<c.max_attempts AND (c.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR c.next_attempt_at<=#{now}) AND (c.campaign_id IS NULL OR(p.status='RUNNING' AND p.dispatch_enabled=TRUE)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM taskreceipt r WHERE r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.idempotency_key=CONCAT('dial:',c.id,':',c.attempts+1)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM taskoutbox t WHERE t.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND t.idempotency_key=CONCAT('dial:',c.id,':',c.attempts+1)) ORDER BY c.updated_at,c.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM taskoutbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_type='dial_call' AND state IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND available_at<=#{now} LIMIT 1000) ready

SELECT t.* FROM taskoutbox t FORCE INDEX(ix_taskoutbox_ready_scope) WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND t.task_type='dial_call' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dial_command_journal j WHERE j.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND j.call_id=t.aggregate_id AND j.attempt=JSON_EXTRACT(t.payload_json,'$.attempt')+1) AND t.available_at<=#{now} AND t.attempts<t.max_attempts AND (t.state IN ('PENDING','FAILED') OR(t.state='PROCESSING' AND t.locked_at<=#{cutoff})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM taskoutbox older WHERE older.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND older.aggregate_id=t.aggregate_id AND older.task_type=t.task_type AND older.state IN ('PENDING','FAILED','PROCESSING') AND (older.created_at<t.created_at OR(older.created_at=t.created_at AND older.id<t.id))) ORDER BY t.available_at,t.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE taskoutbox FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) SET state='PROCESSING',attempts=attempts+1,locked_at=#{now},lease_token=#{lease},updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM taskoutbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_type='dial_call' AND state='PROCESSING' AND locked_at<=#{cutoff} AND attempts>=max_attempts LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM taskoutbox FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE taskoutbox FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) SET state='DEAD',lease_token=NULL,locked_at=NULL,last_error='worker stopped during final dial attempt',updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_type='dial_call' AND state='PROCESSING' AND locked_at<=#{cutoff} AND attempts>=max_attempts AND id IN #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT e.call_session_id,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.payload,'$.attempt')) AS attempt FROM callevent e JOIN callsession c ON c.id=e.call_session_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.event_type='dial_command_accepted' AND e.call_session_id IN #{id}
